units.source_text: 声音未落，天降的三叉戟便刺死了杜子春。

en.t: Before the voice had even faded, the trident descending from the heavens pierced Du Zichun to death.

units.source_text: 接着，天降的笑声回荡在峨眉山间，转瞬便又消失无踪。

en.t: Then laughter from the heavens echoed among the slopes of Mount Emei, and in an instant vanished again without a trace.

units.source_text: 不用多说，这时候那无数的天兵也已经随着夜风，被吹散的无影无踪。

en.t: Needless to say, by then those countless heavenly soldiers had already been scattered by the night wind until no sign of them remained.
